sessionHeader: SYNTHETIC SESSION (Hindi-English code-mixed). Fictional client c04 (Vikram I.), session 2026-10-15. Not a real person.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Vikram ji, kaisa raha yeh hafta?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Theek tha, actually. Metro mein teen stations akele gaya, Rajiv Chowk tak.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Teen stations! Panic kitna tha?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Shuru mein seven, phir grounding ki, 5-4-3-2-1, aur das minute mein four pe aa gaya.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: That's real progress. Aapko kaisa laga?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Proud, thoda. Pehli baar laga ki main kar sakta hoon.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Aur drinking diary?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Monday se Thursday, teen din bilkul nahi piya. Wednesday ko office ka dinner tha, wahan do peg.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Teen out of four. Last time do the. How did you manage the three days?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Raat ko walk pe gaya, aur chai pi. Neend thodi late aayi but aa gayi.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Walk aur chai. That's a good swap. Layoff wali tension kaisi hai?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Abhi announce nahi hua. Wait karna mushkil hai.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Wait karne mein mind kya bolta hai?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Ki main hi niklunga. Ki family ka kya hoga.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Woh worry real hai. Kya hum agle session mein uspe kaam karein, ek plan banake?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Haan, yeh achha rahega.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Is hafte ke liye: metro, chaar stations, aur weekday pe no drinking, same target.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Theek hai.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Main aapko WhatsApp pe Hindi mein reminder bhej dungi.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Haan, aur please meri wife ko kuch mat bhejna.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Bilkul, sirf aapko. Next session 22 ko?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Done.

items.text: Previous session noted drinking had increased again and work stress after a layoff announcement at his company.
Travelled three metro stations alone to Rajiv Chowk. Panic started at 7/10 and fell to 4 within ten minutes using 5-4-3-2-1 grounding.
items.evidence: das minute mein four pe aa gaya

items.text: Drinking diary: no alcohol on three of four days (Mon–Thu); two pegs at an office dinner on Wednesday. Coped with walks and chai; sleep slightly late.
Anxious about the unannounced layoff; waiting is hard. Thoughts of being the one let go and worry about family.
items.evidence: Ki main hi niklunga. Ki family ka kya hoga.

items.text: Felt proud about the metro trip.
items.evidence: Pehli baar laga ki main kar sakta hoon.

items.text: Asked that his wife not be sent anything.
items.evidence: please meri wife ko kuch mat bhejna

items.text: Next session to work on layoff worry by making a plan; client agreed.
This week: metro for four stations and no weekday drinking, same target. Client agreed.
items.evidence: metro, chaar stations, aur weekday pe no drinking

items.text: Clinician to send WhatsApp reminder in Hindi to client only. Next session on the 22nd.
